items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: I went with the Piedhorn band. That was two boats. And Piedhorn had Walter Piedhorn playing piano

ctx.x: I have enough space to quote you word for word. Which boat did you play on? Which of the struck was?

Well, the person I played was Fred Marwell. That was the capital. It was the wooden boat. The capital. Oh, yeah. And they had another boat called Deluxe. I believe it would come down in the summertime. And then after sitting there, they let me go and I went with the Piedhorn band. That was two boats. And Piedhorn had Walter Piedhorn playing piano, and Walter Piedhorn was such a versatile and talented man, so the captain told him, next season you could get your band together and say, we're going to have your band.…
These were the excursion boats, not the Password? The excursion boats, yeah. Not the Password.
